Nine-stage loop

For each stage record input evidence, a named accountable person, a falsifiable exit and observed result. Not-run is not completion; a desk design is not deployed product state.

Stage Named owner Evidence required / source version Exit criterion Actual evidence / date / mode Status and next action
01 Qualify [ ] Baseline, readiness, scope, decision owner [ ] [ ] [ ]
02 Discover [ ] Actual estate, documents, permissions; distinguish synthetic inventory [ ] [ ] [ ]
03 Frame [ ] Artifact type, simpler alternative, scoped constraints and authority [ ] [ ] [ ]
04 Prove [ ] Bounded test in a verified governed environment [ ] [ ] [ ]
05 Build [ ] Runnable artifact and type-supported release path [ ] [ ] [ ]
06 Assure [ ] Applicable checkers, fixed evaluation set and negative tests [ ] [ ] [ ]
07 Operate [ ] Measured outcomes, incidents, monitoring and accountable operator [ ] [ ] [ ]
08 Transfer [ ] Receiving owner runs harness and ships an authorized scoped change while observed [ ] [ ] [ ]
09 Compound [ ] Dated reassessment, individually named reused artifacts and engagement-two evidence [ ] [ ] [ ]

Stage-to-product support and evidence: platform decision record. Human agent decisions: agent decision record. Reuse/falsification: asset record.

Constraint delivery and action truth

Instruction set, constraint register and harness must each have owner, version and expiry. For every executor call, record request ID, attached in-scope constraint IDs/versions, excluded scope and returned ACK evidence. An ACK proves receipt only, not compliance, approval or enforcement. Missing/stale/wrong-scope ACK means HOLD the governed work.

If using a plugin, record actual enabled tools and version, authoritative project folder and operator role. An unavailable/disabled tool is BLOCKED with its actual capability/denial evidence or an explicit not-invoked status. Never invent a plugin result, stage completion or gate release. Desk simulations stay separate from live tool records. No plugin is presumed installed by this field sheet.
